title: "Failed to create a distribution package" Error - Fail to deploy my game

posts.body:

I wonder if there is any more possible causes of this error, and the solutions to them.
Thank you!

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
clsumyee said:
Also, I'm not sure if GIF files are allowed, or are there any "forbidden file types" for RPG Maker MZ?
Click to expand...
The "forbidden" has nothing to do with the maker, it is a general problem of all HTML5-based games.
gif files are not supported by the default maker, but neither are they forbidden - you just need a plugin to install a gif-player for them to work.

posts.author: clsumyee
posts.body:
If I have no plugins for GIF files, should I remove the GIF files?
For the space problem, can I search " " in the file explorer for every file containing spaces? (Including the quotation marks)
Thanks!!

posts.author: Andar
posts.body:
gif: doesn't matter, but any place where it is used it will simply not displayed. so replace them with png
space: yes
